title: Man. Post. Cap. IX: PLAC — how that aids antecedent imputation unclear (pp. 151–153)
pass_a_gloss: Placeus: how that helps antecedent imputation is already on pp. 151–153. Where this reply points, and what force it has, I do not see.
pass_b_english: PLAC. How that was said before, and how much it favors antecedent imputation, we judge to appear sufficiently from what was said above at pages 151, 152, 153. Whither therefore this reply of the learned man pertains, and what force it has, I do not understand.
source_text: PLAC. Quomodo id antea fuerit dictum, & quantum faveat imputationi antecedenti, satis patere arbitramur ex dictis supra pag. 151. 152. 153. Quorsum igitur pertineat, & quam vim habeat haec Viri docti responsio, non intelligo.

choices.choice: Unclear how this aids antecedent imputation (pp. 151–153)
